name: kdd-codex
description: A deterministic KDD workflow skill for planning, implementation, and verification.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, build, and verify work with deterministic KDD contracts.
interface.longDescription: Guides developers through Knowledge-Driven Development with scoped contracts, deterministic validation, and evidence-led completion. This version is skill-only and does not send data or connect to external services.
defaultPrompt: Prepare this task using KDD contracts and verification.
Create a KDD contract and a frozen regression test for this change.
Audit this implementation against its KDD evidence.
